title: Setup routes refuse a plain member three different ways: the settings hub says "No settings registered", a settings page shows a raw capability error inside the Showcase shell, while the Setup app root shows the proper no-access page
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUoS2G4jgqRskpExS7

Found in the 18.3.0 release-candidate browser walkthrough (wave anchor #27377, card W3-UX), at framework `main` @ `c4c515ad`, Console built in-repo from the same commit.

## Repro (fresh boot)

1. Boot `examples/app-showcase` with `--seed-admin`. As admin, invite `member1@example.com` as `member` and complete that person's sign-up. Self-registration is invite-only on stock, so this is the standard door.
2. Sign in as the member. Viewport 1440×900. Open each of these:
   - `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup`
   - `/_console/apps/setup/system/settings`
   - `/_console/apps/setup/system/settings/auth`
   - `/_console/apps/setup/system/settings/localization`

## Expected

Each Setup route refuses the same way the app root does: the clean "You don't have access to this app … Back to home" page.

## Actual

- `/apps/com.objectstack.setup`: the clean no-access page. This is good.
- `/apps/setup/system/settings` (the hub) renders inside the **Showcase** app shell and says **"No settings registered. Plugins can register settings manifests via the SettingsService."** That is false (an admin sees about 20 groups) and developer-facing. The real reason is missing permission.
- `/apps/setup/system/settings/auth` renders inside the Showcase shell with raw red text: **"Access denied: reading settings namespace 'auth' requires the 'manage_platform_settings' capability"**. The localization page says "… requires the 'setup.access' capability".
- **Browse Marketplace** shows a third wording, "App Marketplace is admin-only".

No data is exposed: the server refuses each read. Only the presentation is wrong. The member gets a misleading empty state on one route, an engine message on another, and lands in the wrong app shell.
